reviews.text: Good prices my dog loved it. Customer service could use some work and their website often has times that allow you to schedule and then are unavailable.
It is a little hard to find but worth it. Went for a nail trim. They did an excellent job managing my two nervous pups. Will be going here exclusively moving forward. Highly recommend.

I have been going to bark and bark for Almost 2 years and they do such a phenomenal job every time. They are so sweet and you can tell they really love the animals. Their work is consistent and we have never had any issues. 10/10 recommend!

We had a 10/10 experience with Michael! He did such a great job grooming our dog. Our dog came back looking clean, happy, and smelling great. You can tell Michael really takes his time. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend him to anyone looking for a groomer!
Best nail experience for my pup ever.
Got back a good looking handsome dog
Thank you for the 5 Star Review!  We really appreciate your business!

I never would cheat on my boy's groomer but in a pinch, Bark&Bark came through. Same day appointment, warm and comfortable facility and with experienced and engaging owners. The cut was great, my dog was happy. Def recommend to anyone in the downtown midtown area.

Happy with the service I got, the grooming is very neat, a little short but still looks good. We have a multipoo so hopped that the face can cut a little bit more rounded next time. Will come back again for grooming.

I was turned down by two other groomers because my chihuahua was too reactive (totally understandable) so I was truly so discouraged.

When I called bark and bark I explained the situation and they said they had experience with these types of dogs before so they would be able to help. OMG they were angels!!

They groomed my spicy little boy and were able to deal with the reactivity. I am so so happy that I found them. They are also very communicative as to when the dog is done.

I am truly so happy with them and can't thank them enough. I have another little girl puppy who is also a bit reactive but I am comfortable being able to have somewhere to go that will work with me and my dogs.
Michael does an amazing job with my Toby Bear! I am so glad to have a go-to groomer in the neighborhood! Thanks Bark & Bark!

I brought both my chihuahuas here to be groomed for the first time. What a gem! My guys can both be really anxious and standoffish. They were welcomed in so kindly and I felt really comfortable leaving them to get their baths and trims. I picked them up with shiny coats and a compliment that they both did really well! 11/10 experience and will be returning regularly! Highly recommend
Bark and Bark are absolutely amazing! I highly recommend, they are friendly, provide great customer service, and truly love dogs. My dog always leaves looking fabulous and happy.
Very great and professional
These groomers are AMAZING! my puppy is never afraid to come here and when he comes home he's so soft and fuzzy and looks like a baby!  And he smells soooooo good! Best place!❤️
Thank you so much! We love bringing our dog here for his grooming!
Thank you for the 5 Star Review!  Its always a pleasure to see you and groom Mr. Peanut!
Allison does such an amazing job in our sweet boy Po. She is kind and loving, but get the job done!! We cannot recommend her enough!!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Bark & Bark Grooming! They did a truly fantastic job with my two pups, Puka and Vincenzo. Both of them came out looking absolutely amazing, smelling fresh, and you can tell they felt so comfortable and cared for during their visit. The team was professional, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they do.

It’s not always easy finding a groomer you can fully trust, but Bark & Bark exceeded all my expectations. They paid close attention to detail, listened to exactly what I wanted, and went above and beyond to make sure my pups looked their best.

Puka and Vincenzo are already excited for their next appointment, and I wouldn’t take them anywhere else. Highly recommend Bark & Bark Grooming to anyone looking for top-quality grooming and loving care for their pets!

This is a hidden gem and we are so happy to have found this amazing place. ❤️
Bark & Bark truly cares for your pet with love and attention. My long-haired terrier, who can be quite anxious, has had a few disappointing experiences with groomers around town. But Bark & Bark is different, I always leave with a happy and well-groomed pup!

Owner is a thin-skinned jerk who canceled my 3rd appointment after I complained about my first 2 appointments being auto-canceled by his glitchy reservation system. I guess he didn’t like my attitude so he told me he didn’t want my business. Fine with me, plenty of groomers in this town who won’t cancel 3 appointments back to back.

I am so pleased with the service here! They were so kind and friendly.  They took such great care of my large puppy and gave him so much relief from his matted hair that occurred after swimming. He loved them immediately. They even sent me a message about his ears that were bothering him, and helped direct me to find a solution. It shows they care.  I will definitely be returning! Thank you!
Excellent as always

But they definitely leave your fur baby Flawless 🏆🛁 Keeping your furry friend looking their best is no small task. It’s all about that post-groom glow that gets tails wagging and hearts melting.

Michael is absolutely amazing to work with, and all the staff make my dogs look like show dogs. They even put up with my dogs’ idiosyncrasies without any hesitation. If I could give them 10 stars, I would.
Both of my dogs left looking great! They left happy and it was evident the grooming process was stress free for them. Thanks!

Bark & Bark is amazing! They went above and beyond to accommodate our last-minute request and took such great care of all three of our fur babies. The team was kind, professional, and made the whole experience seamless. Our pups came back looking adorable, feeling fresh, and clearly well cared for. We’re so grateful for their flexibility and fantastic service—highly recommend!
